name: Vice
summary: Deadwind ogres hold the Vice beside the road to Karazhan. Their camps and earthen mounds mark a bleak, scarred stretch of Deadwind Pass, where travelers face brute strength and dark magic.

sections.title: A Desolate Stronghold
sections.body:
The Deadwind ogres hold camps across southern Deadwind Pass, beside the road toward Karazhan. Their rough mounds rise among barren earth and jagged rock. Vengeful ghosts and scavenger vultures haunt much of the canyon, yet the ogres defend their camps with fierce violence.

Travelers on the road between Duskwood and the Swamp of Sorrows must cross their territory. No one knows why the clan chose this bleak, magically scarred waste.

sections.title: Brute Force and Dark Arts
sections.body:
Deadwind ogres fight with heavy weapons and dangerous arcane magic. Among them, Deadwind warlocks practice crude but lethal fel sorceries among the earthen mounds. Their camps lie close to Karazhan, the abandoned seat of Medivh.

The road through the canyon is perilous for wandering scholars and solitary scouts.

faq.answer: The Vice is a rugged stretch of southern Deadwind Pass, where rocky ravines and earthen mounds mark the Deadwind ogres’ camps.

faq.q: Why are the ogres living here?
aliases: why are ogres at the vice
faq.answer: No one knows why the ogres settled in this inhospitable, haunted gorge. Their warlocks may seek lingering magic from nearby Karazhan, or the clan may use the remote mountain road to prey on travelers.

faq.q: Where does the road through the Vice lead?
faq.answer: The road through the Vice winds into the crags of southern Deadwind Pass and leads toward Karazhan, the abandoned tower of the Guardian Medivh.

faq.q: What dangers should travelers expect in the Vice?
aliases: what attacks you in the vice
faq.answer: Travelers face aggressive Deadwind ogres who patrol the road and defend their mounds. The clan includes hulking brawlers and warlocks who wield curses and shadow magic.

angles.text: The Deadwind ogres of the Vice wield dark magic. Even an isolated brute clan can tap into corruptive fel energies.
The ogres camp along the direct approach to Karazhan. Their presence raises questions for the Kirin Tor about whether lingering energies from Medivh’s tower influence the local beasts and clans.
